config_file_disable_https_check.description: If true, disables HTTPS certificate validation (mirrors --disable-https-check).

config_file_mailto.description: Email address to which reports are sent in --cron mode. May contain macros (%s(hostname|fqdn|ip)s).

config_file_report.description: Controls whether debsecan does any processing in --cron mode.

config_file_source.description: URL from which vulnerability information is fetched. If empty, the built-in default is used.

config_file_subject.description: Subject line of email reports. May contain macros (%s(hostname|fqdn|ip)s).
